segments.mil5.2.2:1.2: ‘natthānanda tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhī’ti, puna ca therena mālukyaputtena [māluṅkyaputtena (sī. syā. pī.) saṃ. ni.4.95; a. ni.1.4.257 passitabbaṃ] pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākāsi.
segments.mil5.2.2:1.3: Eso kho, bhante nāgasena, pañho dvayanto [dvayato (sī.)] ekantanissito bhavissati ajānanena vā guyhakaraṇena vā.
segments.mil5.2.2:1.5: ‘natthānanda tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhī’ti, tena hi therassa mālukyaputtassa ajānantena na byākataṃ.
segments.mil5.2.2:1.6: Yadi jānantena na byākataṃ, tena hi atthi tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhi.
segments.mil5.2.2:1.7: Ayampi ubhato koṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo”ti.
segments.mil5.2.2:2.1: “Bhāsitampetaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā ‘natthānanda tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhī’ti, abyākato ca therena mālukyaputtena pucchito pañho, tañca pana na ajānantena na guyhakaraṇena.
segments.mil5.2.2:2.4: Ekaṃsabyākaraṇīyo pañho vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo pañho paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyo pañho ṭhapanīyo pañhoti.
segments.mil5.2.2:3.6: ‘viññāṇaṃ aniccan”ti ekaṃsabyākaraṇīyo pañho, ayaṃ ekaṃsabyākaraṇīyo pañho.
segments.mil5.2.2:4.6: ‘aniccaṃ pana viññāṇan’ti vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo pañho, ayaṃ vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo pañho.
segments.mil5.2.2:5.2: ‘Kiṃ nu kho cakkhunā sabbaṃ vijānātī’ti ayaṃ paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyo pañho.
segments.mil5.2.2:6.12: ‘Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti.
segments.mil5.2.2:6.13: ‘Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti ṭhapanīyo pañho,
segments.mil5.2.2:7.1: “Bhagavā, mahārāja, therassa mālukyaputtassa taṃ ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na byākāsi.
segments.mil5.2.2:7.2: So pana pañho kiṃ kāraṇā ṭhapanīyo?
segments.mil5.2.2:7.3: Na tassa dīpanāya hetu vā kāraṇaṃ vā atthi, tasmā so pañho ṭhapanīyo.
